sentences.text: [thoughtful] "I make good money, and it doesn't feel like it at all." Here's what people your age actually have, and the one thing to check tonight.
Because when you can't tell if you're behind, every purchase feels like a guilty guess.
The Federal Reserve's survey. The middle family under thirty-five has about thirty-nine thousand dollars to its name.
Thirty-five to forty-four: about a hundred and thirty-six thousand.
Forty-five to fifty-four: about two hundred and forty-seven thousand.

visual.title: Median net worth by age
visual.source: Federal Reserve, Survey of Consumer Finances 2022. Home included.

sentences.text: And that's everything: cash, retirement, and the house. If you rent, compare just your cash and retirement, and expect your number to be lower.
[curious] So if you earn well and still feel behind, check one thing tonight. Does saving happen first? Or after a month of guessing what's safe to spend?
DivvyUpp flips it. Savings leaves on payday, the amount you pick.
What's left becomes one number for today. Spend forty over, and the next few days each get a little less. No guessing.
[warm] So, are you behind? Behind isn't one number. It's whether yours goes up every month. Save first. Then spend what's safe. Try it at Divvyup dot com.
